title: Cosmic Mother and Dragon
description: A woman with long dark hair in a flowing dark gown sits in a cosmic nebula, cradling a glowing baby wrapped in ethereal light. A large black bird perches on her shoulder while a white celestial dragon curves above her, surrounded by floating lotus flowers, cherry blossoms, stars, and mystical symbols in a vibrant galaxy background.
